changelog:
- A Jellyfin update can no longer take the server down through Hera: its background jobs and scheduled tasks are isolated, and a failure switches off only that feature.
- Every part of Hera can be switched off on its own from its settings page (Switch off a part of Hera), styles included, and there is a master switch for the whole theme.
- The Dashboard shows what is actually known: problems reported by each browser, server-side faults, and whether the web page was injected, instead of an unconditional all-clear.
- The Jellyfin log gets a startup line with versions, and warnings and errors for Hera failures that used to be silent.
- Hera's data files carry schema versions, unreadable files are kept aside instead of reset, and the settings file is backed up when a new version first starts.
- Stricter compatibility checks run before every release and nightly against new Jellyfin builds.
- Scrolling and remote navigation down the home page no longer stall on the first pass, most noticeably in the TV layout.
description: Apple TV-style theme, home hero and season shelves for the web client.
name: Hera TV
overview: The Apple TV app's look for Jellyfin's web client
